Strictly increasing sequence is a sequence of integers $$$[x_1 \lt x_2 \lt \dots \lt x_k]$$$. And strictly decreasing sequence is a sequence of integers $$$[y_1 \gt y_2 \gt \dots \gt y_l]$$$. Note that the empty sequence and the sequence consisting of one element can be considered as increasing or decreasing.

They were merged into one sequence $$$a$$$. After that sequence $$$a$$$ got shuffled. For example, some of the possible resulting sequences $$$a$$$ for an increasing sequence $$$[1, 3, 4]$$$ and a decreasing sequence $$$[10, 4, 2]$$$ are sequences $$$[1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 10]$$$ or $$$[4, 2, 1, 10, 4, 3]$$$.
This shuffled sequence $$$a$$$ is given in the input.
